dispute_ticket.description: I was charged an $85 cleaning fee. Nothing happened in that car, we just sat there. This is a scam, I want it removed.

chat_logs.content: Hi, I'm at the Clarke Quay pickup point, grey Niro.
sorry about the drink my friend will hold it properly
Please be careful, bubble tea is very hard to clean off the seats.

app_events.details: Rider R-7093 booked trip RYDE-DEMO-016 from Clarke Quay to Pasir Ris.
Driver submitted cleaning claim S$85.00 with 3 photos of a milk tea spill across the rear seat and door pocket. Photo metadata timestamps: 2026-09-25 23:12-23:14 (7 minutes after drop-off at 23:05).
Driver submitted an interior cleaning receipt for S$85.00 dated 2026-09-26 09:40.
S$85.00 cleaning fee charged to rider R-7093.

platform_policy.cleaning_claim_evidence_required: photos taken promptly after the trip and a receipt where available
platform_policy.rider_may_dispute_if: evidence does not show the mess, predates the trip, or the fee exceeds the actual cleaning cost

expected_outcome.reason: The driver's claim meets this trip's evidence policy on every point: photos taken 7 minutes after drop-off show the spill, a receipt matches the S$85 charged, and the fee is far below the S$200 cap. The rider's own chat during the trip ('sorry about the drink') contradicts the claim that nothing happened. The fee stands.
